name: Custom criteria
description: Optional criteria that can be added to any check.

criteria.name: Formality
criteria.description: The register matches the intended reader and situation (formal, neutral or informal) consistently, without slang in formal texts or stiffness in informal ones.

criteria.name: Tone
criteria.description: The tone is polite, appropriate and achieves the intended effect (e.g. persuasive, apologetic, friendly, firm).

criteria.name: Conciseness
criteria.description: Says what is needed without repetition, filler or unnecessarily long sentences.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Ideas and requests are easy to understand on first reading; the purpose of the text is clear.

criteria.name: Length
criteria.description: The text respects the requested word limits (5 = within limits, lower scores the further outside them) and its length suits the task.
